values: A Grassmann proof of the Catalan divisor in the Teufl–Wagner forest transfer determinant. Accepted scope: For all n>=1, the generic full Bell-partition forest transfer determinant over Z[a_ij] is divisible by (det A)^Catalan_n. Limits: No gap asserted for divisibility; exact multiplicity, residual-factor irreducibility and complete factorization not claimed. Prior results and proof dependencies are credited in the paper.
